title: Overcoming the limitations of cardiac MRI: AI-based strategies for acceleration
summary:
The aim of this study is to measure a patient cohort using cardio-MRI to investigate AI-based algorithms for simplified MRI planning, to test deep learning-based sequences for accelerated image acquisition. Deep learning techniques can significantly improve MRI planning, image acquisition and image quality in cardiac MRI. In order to simplify image acquisition and make it possible for less experienced users, deep learning-based planning of the heart section planes will be tested.  As part of the same MRI examination, deep learning-based accelerated cine images in free breathing will also be quantitatively investigated.
In order to test the application of the sequences under free breathing under clinical conditions, the sequences will be tested in a patient cohort at the end of the clinically indicated cardiac MRI.

interventions.name: Patients who have a clinical indication for a cardiac MRI are examined following their clinical examination using innovative AI-supported cardiac MRI sequences. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age > 18 years at the time of the study
- Subject's ability to understand and voluntarily sign a written informed consent form after being given an overview of the nature and purpose of this study
Exclusion criteria:
- Pregnancy
- General contraindications for an MRI examination (non-MRI-capable implants, claustrophobia)
